## Summary

What does this change add or fix, and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...`, `golangci-lint run ./...`, and `golangci-lint fmt --diff ./...` pass.
- [ ] New behaviour has tests and is documented in the README.
- [ ] Output never contains a proxy password, and the change contains no real credentials.
